newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama to award $30 mln water plant project.
newsitem.headline: Panama to award $30 mln water plant project.

text.p: Panama will award this month a contract to build a $30 million water treatment plant near Panama City, a top government official said Monday.
"We're in the final review process. We should go to the opening of the financial offers by the end of the month," Alfredo Macia, head of the government's privatization program, said.

Six international firms from Britain, France, Italy, Spain and Japan qualified last year to build a 20 million-gallon-per-day water treatment plant to supply the Panama City metropolitan area with drinking water for 20 years. Macia did not name them.
The plant will be about 20 miles (30 km) from Panama City and will sell the water to the government-run water department. No information was available on when construction would begin.
